value.name: couple wakes in bed
value.description: Miles and Marylin are shown asleep together in bed before the morning alarm wakes them.
evidence: Miles and Marylin asleep in bed.
The ALARM RINGS.

value.name: Miles kisses Marylin good morning
value.description: Miles wakes and affectionately kisses Marylin as a morning greeting.
evidence: Miles wakes, turns to his beautiful wife -- kisses her good morning.

value.name: Marylin smiles sleepily
value.description: Marylin responds to Miles with a sleepy smile, showing their tenderness.
evidence: She gives him a sleepy Smile.

value.name: Marylin prepares Miles for work
value.description: While Miles dresses, Marylin brings him coffee and helps him choose a tie.
evidence: Miles dressing for work.
Marylin, in a Sabia Rosa bathrobe, places a tray with coffee next to him.
He holds up two ties for her approval.
She selects one.
He puts it on.

value.name: couple shares breakfast and laughter
value.description: Miles and Marylin read newspapers while eating breakfast and laugh together over the meal.
evidence: Miles and Marylin reading Newspapers while eating breakfast.
She serves him a bowl of fruit and indicates Wrigley's berry spoons.
They laugh heartily.

value.name: Marylin sees Miles off to work
value.description: Marylin waves goodbye as Miles leaves the house and drives to the office.
evidence: Marylin waves goodbye as Miles backs out and drives to the office.

value.name: Marylin waves to gardeners
value.description: After Miles leaves, Marylin acknowledges the gardeners as they blow palm fronds around the lawn.
evidence: She waves at the gardeners who blow palm fronds around the lawn.

value.name: Miles displays married-life photos
value.description: At his office, Miles has filled his credenza with pictures documenting married life.
evidence: MILES OFFICE.
He has managed to fill his credenza with pictures of married life.
Due to its brevity -- these pictures are uneventful, the Massey's wear the same outfit in most of them.

value.name: Miles receives call from Marylin
value.description: Miles is interrupted at work when his secretary tells him Marylin is on the line.
evidence: He is interrupted by the voice of his SECRETARY.
SECRETARY: I have Mrs. Massey on line one for you.

value.name: Miles laughs at Marylin's call
value.description: Miles answers the phone, calls Marylin 'Mom,' and laughs as her laughter comes through the receiver.
evidence: Miles picks up.
MILES: Mom...?
He laughs and laughs.
We hear Marylin's laughter coming through the receiver.
